title: Mogrol-mediated enhancement of radiotherapy sensitivity in non-small cell lung cancer: a mechanistic study.
authors: Yin, Zhongbo; Zhang, Xuedong; Sun, Xiao; Huo, Yunlong; Ji, Nan; Chen, Keyan
journal: American journal of physiology. Cell physiology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Mogrol通过ERK/CREB通路下调USP22增强非小细胞肺癌放疗敏感性，属纯湿实验与临床机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study investigated mogrol's impact on non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) radiosensitivity and underlying mechanisms, using various methods including assays, bioinformatics, and xenograft models. CCK-8, clonogenic, flow cytometry, TUNEL, and Western blot assays evaluated mogrol and radiation effects on NSCLC viability and apoptosis. Ubiquitin-specific protease 22 (USP22) expression in NSCLC patient tissues was determined by RT-qPCR and Western blot. A xenograft model validated mogrol's effects on tumor growth. Bioinformatics identified four ubiquitin-specific proteases, including USP22, in NSCLC. Kaplan-Meier analysis confirmed USP22's value in lung cancer survival. Human Protein Atlas (HPA) database analysis indicated higher USP22 expression in lung cancer tissues. Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) analysis implicated ERK1/2 in NSCLC progression, and molecular docking showed stability between mogrol and ERK1/2. Further in vivo and in vitro experiments have demonstrated that mogrol enhances the inhibitory effect of radiation on NSCLC cell viability and clonogenic capacity. Cell viability and clonogenic capacity are reduced by >50%, and an increase in cellular apoptosis is observed, with apoptotic levels reaching 10%. USP22 expression was significantly elevated in NSCLC tissues, particularly in radiotherapy-resistant patients. Mogrol downregulated USP22 expression by inhibiting the ERK/CREB pathway, lowering COX2 expression. Mogrol also enhanced radiation's inhibition of tumor growth in mice. Mogrol enhances NSCLC radiosensitivity by downregulating USP22 via the ERK/CREB pathway, leading to reduced COX2 expression.NEW & NOTEWORTHY Mogrol enhances non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) cell sensitivity to radiotherapy by downregulating USP22 through the ERK/CREB pathway, reducing COX2 expression. These findings highlight mogrol's potential as an adjunct to improve NSCLC radiotherapy and open avenues for further research and clinical applications.
abstract_zh:
本研究探讨了罗汉果醇（mogrol）对非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）放射敏感性的影响及其潜在机制，采用了包括实验检测、生物信息学分析和异种移植模型等多种方法。通过CCK-8、克隆形成、流式细胞术、TUNEL和Western blot实验评估了罗汉果醇和辐射对NSCLC细胞活力和凋亡的影响。利用RT-qPCR和Western blot检测了NSCLC患者组织中泛素特异性蛋白酶22（USP22）的表达。异种移植模型验证了罗汉果醇对肿瘤生长的作用。生物信息学分析鉴定出NSCLC中四种泛素特异性蛋白酶，包括USP22。Kaplan-Meier分析确认了USP22在肺癌生存中的价值。人类蛋白质图谱（HPA）数据库分析显示，肺癌组织中USP22表达较高。基因本体论（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）分析提示ERK1/2参与NSCLC进展，分子对接显示罗汉果醇与ERK1/2之间具有稳定性。进一步的体内和体外实验表明，罗汉果醇增强了辐射对NSCLC细胞活力和克隆形成能力的抑制作用。细胞活力和克隆形成能力降低超过50%，并观察到细胞凋亡增加，凋亡水平达到10%。USP22在NSCLC组织中表达显著升高，尤其是在放疗抵抗患者中。罗汉果醇通过抑制ERK/CREB通路下调USP22表达，降低COX2水平。罗汉果醇还增强了辐射对小鼠肿瘤生长的抑制作用。罗汉果醇通过ERK/CREB通路下调USP22，进而减少COX2表达，从而增强NSCLC的放射敏感性。

新意与亮点 罗汉果醇通过ERK/CREB通路下调USP22，减少COX2表达，从而增强非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）细胞对放疗的敏感性。这些发现凸显了罗汉果醇作为辅助手段改善NSCLC放疗的潜力，并为进一步研究和临床应用开辟了途径。
